verifications.claim: As of 2024–2026, NASA astronauts are paid based on the U.S. government’s General Schedule (GS) scale.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'This pay rate reflect the 2024 pay schedules'; R3: 'pay grades for civilian astronauts are GS-11 through GS-14'; R4/R6: 'paid on a "General Services" pay scale... classified as GS-13 employees'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm GS scale for 2024, with projections into 2025; 2026 is extension but supported as ongoing federal scale.

verifications.claim: NASA astronauts typically earn around $152,258 per year.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1/R2/R4/R5/R6: 'average salary of a NASA astronaut is around USD 152,258' or '$152,258 per year (as of 2024)'
verifications.reasoning: Exact figure repeatedly stated as average/typical salary.

verifications.claim: NASA astronauts' average salary is approximately $152,258 per year (2024–2026 data).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: '$152,258.00 Per year. This pay rate reflect the 2024 pay schedules and are an approximation. This rate will be adjusted to reflect any increase in 2025'; similar in others
verifications.reasoning: Direct match for average/approximation in 2024-2025; 2026 minor extrapolation but not contradicted.

verifications.claim: FederalPay.org estimates indicate a salary range of roughly $89,693 to $122,336+ for astronauts depending on experience.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4/R6: 'FederalPay.org estimates NASA astronauts are often paid anywhere from $89,693 to $122,336 per year'
verifications.reasoning: Exact range and source cited, '+' aligns with 'often' and steps.

verifications.claim: Salaries for civilian astronauts range from GS-11 to GS-14/15 levels.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R3: 'pay grades for civilian astronauts are GS-11 through GS-14'; R4: 'classified as GS-13 employees, some of the highest on the 15-point scale'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm GS-11 to GS-14; '/15' broader than precise support but not contradicted.

verifications.claim: Military astronauts receive pay and benefits from their respective branches.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'military astronauts... get their salary from the military system'; R2: 'remain in an active-duty status for pay, benefits'; R3: 'receive their military pay, benefits and leave'

verifications.claim: There is no overtime pay for space missions.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'astronauts are not given any payment for overtime'; R4/R6: 'they didn't receive any extra compensation... do not receive overtime'

verifications.claim: Canadian Space Agency (CSA) astronauts have salaries ranging from $97,100 to $189,600 (2023 data).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4/R6: 'salary scale for Levels I to III varies from $97,100 to $189,600, according to 2023 data'

verifications.claim: Astronauts do not receive bonuses for spaceflight.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'not given any extra payment for space missions'; R5: 'don't receive performance bonuses'; R7: 'No performance bonus'
verifications.reasoning: Direct confirmations of no extra/bonus pay for missions.

verifications.claim: Astronauts are paid their standard salary while in space.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4/R6: 'receive regular, 40-hour....week salaries... aboard the International Space Station'; R5: 'earn the same as financial analysts'
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly standard salary continues in space.

verifications.claim: Transportation and lodging are provided to astronauts while in space.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4/R6/R7: 'transportation (the rockets...), lodging (aboard... ISS), and meals... taken care of'; R5: 'transportation, lodging, and meals are provided'

verifications.claim: Astronauts receive a roughly $5/day stipend for incidentals while in space.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R7: 'receive a small daily stipend—about $5—for incidentals'

verifications.claim: Civilian astronauts are paid according to the federal GS-11 to GS-15 scale.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R3: 'GS-11 through GS-14'; R4: 'GS-13 employees, some of the highest on the 15-point scale'
verifications.reasoning: Sources specify up to GS-14 max; no support for GS-15 for astronauts.

verifications.claim: Civilian astronaut pay is influenced by locality pay (e.g., Houston, TX).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4/R6: 'pay is determined by... their location. All NASA astronauts... based out of the Johnson Space Center in Houston, Texas'
verifications.reasoning: GS scale includes locality pay; Houston explicitly noted as base.

verifications.claim: Active-duty military astronauts remain on their service payroll.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'remain in an active-duty status for pay'; R3: 'remain in active duty and receive their military pay'

verifications.claim: Military service payroll can differ from civilian civil service pay.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: 'military... get their salary from the military system'; R3: 'military pay' vs 'GS' for civilians
verifications.reasoning: Separate systems described; difference implied but not explicitly stated.

verifications.claim: Astronaut benefits include federal health plans.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'health insurance'; R3: 'number of health plans... partially offset by the government'
verifications.reasoning: Direct mention of federal health benefits.

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'life insurance options; premium payments... partially offset by the government'

verifications.claim: Astronaut benefits include a three-tiered retirement plan.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Federal Employees Retirement System (FERS), a three-tiered retirement plan'
